title.narrative: Supporting schools with minor rehabilitation and integrated protection services in in Rural Damascus, Deir ez-Zor and Aleppo

description.narrative: ltpgtThis project, which will be implemented within a full year, will contribute to the humanitarian response plan within the education and protection sector. SSSD will target the most in-need areas on the scale of the 4-severity scale. As the education and protection sector reports indicate, 3 selected schools will be rehabilitated in coordination with the MoE and planning directorates in the governorates of Aleppo, Rural Damascus, and Deir-ez-Zor. ltbrgtThe schools will be lightly rehabilitated, water and sewage systems will be maintained, schools will be provided with a solar power system and 60 rows will be provided with tables, seats, as well as boards, and teachers' supplies, where more than 2,500 students will benefit.ltbrgtCompensatory education courses for 1500 of the most vulnerable children will be implemented in the three rehabilitated schools in addition to helping 200 dropout children in order to return back to school and compensating their lost education. Furthermore, school bags, notebooks and stationery will be distributed to 1700 students in the their schools. 105 teachers in these schools will be provided with the needed tools to carry out their lessons. Furthermore, child protection awareness will be conducted for 3,200 students and caregivers.ltbrgtThis project will focus on attracting children with disabilities (2% of the target) by facilitating their access to schools and rehabilitating schools to ensure the integration of children with disabilities. ltbrgtThe project team will work to reach out to children of employment and girls at risk of gender-based violence, also mitigate the risks associated with unexploded ordnance and promoting a safer living environment. The project will also contribute to providing job opportunities for some of the families of children who have dropped out due labor, as case managers will refer these children to the livelihoods team, which will contribute to supporting the families starting up their small businesses to bring back their drop-out children to school.ltbrgtThe project is expected to contribute to alleviate the suffering of the population in the targeted areas, and will ensure that more than 2,500 children will have access to their right of education. It will also alleviate parents' financial burdens to secure education for their children and contribute to children's access to adequate protection. It will also contribute to the restoration of those schools' infrastructure and human resources, which can last for so many years.ltbrgtAlso, SSSD will conduct child protection services in order to decrease CP risks for the parents and children.lt/pgt
